svg.title: Haunts Mono typed headline
svg.desc: Frame sequence of Mono's typed headline, light and dark, with a timing diagram.
svg.text: Mono's typed headline (D45): typed in, held, then the next; the cursor keeps blinking

Mono's styling of the moving headline appearance, only if the user chose it (HEAD-2). One pass per open, then it rests on a full sentence. The pause control stops both typing and blinking, and stays paused.
cursor hidden 0.5 s of each 1 s
6.8 s · clears at once, types next
end of pass · full sentence, keeps blinking
cursor hidden 0.5 s of each 1 s
6.8 s · clears at once, types next
end of pass · full sentence, keeps blinking
One open, one pass, at most 3 facts (2 shown). Proposed timings, to be signed off on a device:
rest on full sentence, blinking until paused or off screen
Screen reader, Reduce Motion or Remove animations: the full sentence at once with a steady cursor (HEAD-10, HEAD-11); read once, as a whole, when focused.

No sound, no variation in typing speed, no 'new' marker. Blink period 1.0 s (0.5 s on, 0.5 s off) = one flash a second, a third of SC 2.3.1's limit. Blinking over 5 s is covered by the pause control (SC 2.2.2).
